_comment: THE per-site identity file — the only file that changes between loisirs74/73/38/…  Engine scripts read it via scripts/siteconfig.py and must never hardcode these values. department.name_i18n is deliberately ABSENT here: the 73 freezes the French place name in every language per docs/LAUNCH-PLAN.md, so dept_name(lang) falls back to "Savoie" everywhere. The 74 needs it because it renders "Alta Savoia" and "Alta Saboya".
_paid_partner_comment: Domains whose links exist because of a PAID, CONTRACTUAL placement — they must carry rel=sponsored per Google's link-spam policy, which is enforced algorithmically with no manual action to warn you. EMPTY on this site: the 73 sells no placements yet. Its outbound links are editorial source citations (venue sites, tourist offices, patrimoines.savoie.fr) and must stay FOLLOWED — they are the evidence layer, not advertising. Add a host here the day a placement is sold; mark_sponsored_links.py and gate_sponsored_links.py are already wired and will cover it automatically.
